description: Header file defining the QuicClientDefaultNetworkHelper class, which implements network helper functionalities for QUIC client using QuicEventLoop API, including socket creation, event handling, and packet processing.

classes.name: QuicClientDefaultNetworkHelper
classes.description: Implements network helper functionalities for QUIC client, managing UDP sockets, event loop integration, and packet processing.

methods.name: QuicClientDefaultNetworkHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the network helper with event loop and client references.

methods.name: OnSocketEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events such as readability or writability.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes incoming packets received on the socket.

methods.name: RunEventLoop
methods.description: Runs the event loop for network operations.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndBind
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket to a specified address and port.

methods.name: CleanUpAllUDPSockets
methods.description: Cleans up all created UDP sockets.

methods.name: GetLatestClientAddress
methods.description: Returns the most recent client address.

methods.name: CreateQuicPacketWriter
methods.description: Creates a packet writer for QUIC packets.

methods.name: GetLatestFD
methods.description: Returns the latest socket file descriptor, or -1 if none.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocket
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket for a given server address, indicating if overflow is supported.

methods.name: CleanUpUDPSocket
methods.description: Unregisters and closes a specified UDP socket.

methods.name: SetClientPort
methods.description: Sets the client port for testing purposes.

methods.name: AllowFdsToBeUnregisteredExternally
methods.description: Allows external code to unregister sockets.

methods.name: BindInterfaceNameIfNeeded
methods.description: Binds a socket to a specific network interface if needed.

methods.name: CleanUpUDPSocketImpl
methods.description: Performs actual cleanup of a socket file descriptor.
